$comment: Case Studies dark-glass design tokens. DEVELOPER CONFIG, not editable copy — do NOT hand this to the CMS. `gradientText` is a React inline-style object (camelCase CSS keys) applied to the gradient headline. The `card*` tokens are the card's own text colours and are deliberately brighter than `body`/`muted`: those two are tuned for the left panel sitting on the bare galaxy backdrop, and reusing them on the lit glass card left the ledger labels near 3:1 contrast — unreadable at 9.5px. They reach the card as CSS custom properties so :hover rules can override them.
